notes.title: Math Path Challenge!
notes.notes:
[h1]Are you ready to win!?[/h1]

[h3]100 steam keys and 3 gift cards!
[/h3]
The game is out of early access, which means that it's time for the contest!
You are rewarded only for your intelligence and effort.

[h2]What should I do!?[/h2]
To win the main prize, you need to pass the game as far as possible. Post screenshots of your progress in the game with the caption "Math Path Challenge for Gift Card" so that we can evaluate your results!

[h2]But that's not all,[/h2]
 [h3]post screenshots, guides, reviews, and videos to win keys to steam games.[/h3] The most original publications will receive steam keys without a competition!

The competition will run until July 23, 2020. If the number of participants exceeds 200, the prize fund will increase.

We will announce the winners on July 24. Among the participants who have reached the highest level, gift cards will be drawn, the card's final will be determined by the number of participants, the higher they are, the higher the prize money!

notes.title: Trading Cards Ready!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Math Path trading cards are ready![/b][/h1]
For realise we need Your support!
The fact is that to get Trading Cards, we need to collect some indicators in terms of Adding the game to the wishlist, Subscriptions, the Number of Game Launches, and overall activity on the page and in the community of the game :) 

And only You can help us and bring the release of these trading cards closer - please tell all your friends, acquaintances, relatives, Pets about this masterpiece game! 

[h1][b]We will be very grateful to You![/b][/h1]
